questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The live stream with the current lot 'Charizard SAR 223/197' and 'Bidding is turned off' in place of the bid bar says what is happening.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Bidding is turned off ›' takes the bid bar's place at the bottom, the most prominent control.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Bidding is turned off ›' hints it opens more info but doesn't say it leads to 'Contact us'; side icons 'Clip', 'Share', 'Shop' are labelled.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Words like 'Lot #5', 'Following' and 'Shop' are ones a Live viewer knows.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: No decision is asked; the viewer can only watch, chat or open the explanation.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The reason and contact option are behind the 'Bidding is turned off' row rather than shown up front.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything belongs to a viewer watching a live auction.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels carry it; the only prose is chat and a one-line shipping hint.
